summary: Enhance your skills with our Mobile Money and Financial Services for Social Protection training course. Learn to implement effective financial solutions today.
lede: Mobile money for social protection supports programme managers and payment teams in planning accountable cash-transfer delivery. They map beneficiary payment journeys, assess provider suitability and inclusion risks, and track transaction, reconciliation and complaint indicators to identify delivery gaps and exceptions. The training also covers fraud and consumer-protection controls, dashboard design and implementation planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate, supervise, or evaluate mobile money channels used for social protection and government-to-person payments. It suits intermediate learners who already work with programme operations, payment providers, beneficiary data, financial inclusion, or compliance controls.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to social protection operations, government-to-person payments, mobile money, financial inclusion, payment service providers, or programme monitoring. No programming is required. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheets, process maps, payment reports, and operational procedures. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted transaction monitoring, interoperability, and digital identity are taught at the operational application level, while technical platform engineering remains outside scope.
